scope.future_final_assessment_candidate: 2026; known cases exist; cannot claim untouched confirmation
scope.future_truly_unseen_evidence: freeze first, then collect prospective outcomes

event.zero_change_rule: Non-positive class; preserve separate zero count in every report

features.feature_selection_reason: Use the two already defined, evaluable MA structure signals as one three-state grouping; no outcome-frequency ranking. MACD and KDJ remain in the audited artifact but are not hard input gates in this minimal run.

group_model.OTHER: both above signals evaluable and neither equals 1
group_model.MISSING: either above signal is unavailable; abstain

features.standardization: none; no continuous predictor in the two-model minimum

models_in_fixed_order.purpose: Constant benchmark on exactly the same feature-group-evaluable training and validation dates as M1
models_in_fixed_order.fit_population: Only dates with both MA up-structure and down-structure signals nonnull; same masks and minimum fitting gate as M1

models_in_fixed_order.strength_reason: Fixed conservative smoothing for a small group model; not estimated or tuned against any outcomes in this round
models_in_fixed_order.unseen_evaluable_group: p0 through the registered shrinkage formula; explicit group_train_n=0 flag
models_in_fixed_order.small_group_flag: group_train_n < 30; threshold is a display warning and not an evidence certificate

validation.training_window: expanding from 2023-01-03; refit once before each validation quarter
validation.strict_end_rule_reason: A label ending on the first validation day is not known before that validation block starts
validation.validation_anchor_rule: anchors within the registered quarter AND outcome_end <= fold validation_last_anchor; cross-quarter immature outcomes are excluded from that fold evaluation

purge_example.explanation: Their fifth observed-session outcomes end on or after 2023-10-09, despite the calendar holiday gap

validation.fixed_grid_sensitivity: Use every fifth original development anchor beginning 2023-01-03 globally; intersect masks after fixing the grid, do not rephase per fold or choose among five offsets

metrics.clipping_policy: scoring only; save raw p and clipping count
metrics.improvement_sign: negative loss differences or positive Brier skill indicate lower development loss; no automatic deployment or economic claim
metrics.aggregate: Concatenate unique fold predictions and weight each predicted anchor equally; also report each fold in fixed chronological order
metrics.across_model_comparison: M0 and M1 are always evaluated on the identical feature-group-evaluable training and validation support; do not compare a full-coverage M0 with a restricted M1
metrics.calibration_bin_rule: [left,right), last bin closed at 1; report n, mean raw p, observed positive/zero/negative counts, observed Y rate, rate-minus-mean-p
metrics.bin_threshold_reason: Sparse-display flag only; fixed equal-width bins avoid tuning edges to observed errors
metrics.confidence_intervals_this_round: none; no IID binomial intervals, no effective-sample-size fiction

selection_and_budget.model_changes_after_metrics: New protocol version, new trial-log entry; never overwrite the losing run or reset the previous 12-signal exploration history

stage_separation.now: Development fold-out reliability tables only; no fitted calibrator. Do not call these previously explored periods independently validated out-of-sample evidence.
stage_separation.later_calibration: Before opening 2025 outcomes, freeze candidate, preprocessing, calibration family, eligibility, temporal split and dates. Fit any calibrator only in the calibration stage; fitting rows are not final evaluation.
stage_separation.later_final: Before opening 2026 outcomes, freeze the calibrator and full pipeline. One retrospective assessment, disclose known cases and contamination, no untouched claim. Changes require a new evaluation plan and prospective evidence.

pipeline_checks_required: Source hashes, old protocol hash and old risk files unchanged
Only 2023-2024 label table read; generated predictions and scored outcomes never include 2025/2026
Every fitted label end strictly precedes its fold validation first anchor
Feature/preprocessing fit date manifests contain training rows only
Changing validation/future outcomes cannot change model parameters or predictions for that fold
Changing bars after an anchor cannot change that anchor's features
Ex-date resets and warmup masks match the engineering contract
All per-model predictions join to exactly one mature development label and paired baseline
Independent hand checks for Brier, log-loss, Laplace constant rate and group shrinkage
All prediction probabilities finite and within [0,1]; failed/absent predictions retain reasons
Re-run deterministically reproduces fold manifests, predictions and metric tables
All candidate and common-support coverage reconciles with anchor and exclusion ledgers
Every validation label end is at or before its fold validation_last_anchor
M0 and M1 training/validation masks are exactly identical within every fold
Original contract full hash is locked to prior independent source review; all input labels have h=5 and one of the three defined signs

references.title: scikit-learn probability calibration
references.use: Brier/log-loss jointly assess reliability and discrimination; calibration needs separate reliability checks

references.title: scikit-learn model evaluation
references.use: Proper probabilistic scoring; not an economic-profit metric

minimum_training_rows_reason: Engineering run guard only, not a probability-confidence or statistical-power certificate; both models abstain if this gate fails
